text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday, prepared for Reuters by the Estonian news agency ETA. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The Estonian and Norwegian foreign ministers will sign an agreeement on visa-free travel today in Oslo.
- President Lennart Meri appointed Coalition Party member Peep Aru as minister in charge of regional affairs.

- Estonia and Switzerland plan to continue cooperation, with the Swiss side helping to train infantry units and defence planners, developing mobilisation systems and with supplies, Estonian Defence Minister Andrus Oovel said.
- Tallinn city government is contemplating whether to adopt a tax on tourists arriving in the city, officials said.

- Estonian businesses should pay more attention to cutting expenses and concentrate on developing small business, the director of the Japanese Economic Surveys, Takafuni Kaneko, recommended during a visit to Tallinn.
